movie.title: UNABOMBER
movie.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: This tense thriller details Ted Kaczynski's descent from a traumatized Harvard prodigy into the Unabomber, whose deadly 17-year bombing campaign sparks a relentless FBI manhunt.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Brilliant Harvard prodigy Ted Kaczynski undergoes deeply troubling psychological experiments conducted by Professor Henry Murray, setting off a descent into extreme anti-technology fanaticism and isolation. Between 1978 and 1995, Kaczynski carries out a deadly nationwide mail-bombing campaign across the United States that leaves three dead and 23 injured. Decades later, FBI agent Joanne Miller leads a high-stakes investigation to uncover the elusive killer's identity and put an end to his reign of terror. The narrative exposes the haunting backstory and chilling consequences of unbridled psychological manipulation, isolation, and radical ideology.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The narrative delves into the complex life of Ted Kaczynski, beginning with his early days as a gifted young prodigy attending Harvard University. While at Harvard, Kaczynski becomes an unwitting subject in controversial and emotionally abusive psychological experiments orchestrated by Professor Henry Murray. These traumatic experiences deeply scar Kaczynski, fueling a growing paranoia, extreme anti-technology ideology, and a profound alienation from society. Retreating into a secluded cabin, he begins constructing homemade explosive devices to target academics, executives, and airlines. From 1978 to 1995, his terrifying mail-bombing campaign claims three lives and injures 23 others, keeping the entire nation in a constant state of fear. As panic spreads, FBI agent Joanne Miller leads a dedicated, multi-agency investigation to track down the mysterious domestic terrorist. Miller faces immense pressure to piece together cryptic writings and obscure forensic clues to identify the bomber. Decades of trauma and seclusion finally collide as the relentless manhunt closes in on Kaczynski's isolated hideout. Ultimately, the story offers a chilling examination of how brilliant ambition, when warped by psychological cruelty and radical isolation, can breed devastating tragedy.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: UNABOMBER is a gripping psychological thriller and drama that explores the rise and fall of one of America's most infamous domestic terrorists, Ted Kaczynski. Beginning with his youth as an exceptional mathematics prodigy at Harvard, the narrative illuminates his pivotal exposure to coercive psychological testing under Professor Henry Murray. This unsettling trauma seeds a radical retreat into isolation and an escalating hatred of modern technological society. As Kaczynski orchestrates a deadly 17-year campaign of untraceable mail bombs across the United States, FBI agent Joanne Miller spearheads a tense, high-stakes manhunt to decipher his motives and stop the violence. The story balances an intense law enforcement procedural with a dark character study, probing the destructive intersection of genius, psychological abuse, and extreme isolation.

story_structure.climax: A breakthrough in the investigation forces a direct confrontation with Kaczynski's identity, bringing the years-long, intense pursuit to a dramatic head.
story_structure.conflict: Kaczynski launches a deadly, nationwide bombing campaign, while FBI agent Joanne Miller leads a high-stakes manhunt to track down the elusive domestic terrorist.
story_structure.resolution: The capture of the Unabomber brings an end to the reign of terror, leaving behind a sobering reflection on the cost of unchecked ambition and deep isolation.
story_structure.introduction: Ted Kaczynski's early life unfolds, showcasing his transition from a brilliant Harvard prodigy to a recluse shaped by controversial psychological experiments.
story_structure.risingAction: As the body count and fear rise over nearly two decades, investigators struggle with a web of cryptic manifestos, complex bomb designs, and a cold trail.
